## Context / Problem
Four developer-tooling files contain repeated, historical, or stale comments identified by the audit and revalidated on current `origin/main`. Manual pressure probes need concise but complete safety and recovery guidance.

## Approach
Edit only comments/docstrings and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve executable behavior and behavior-bearing directives byte-for-byte. User-facing/manual instructions retain every necessary precondition, failure meaning, and cleanup step.

## Scope
- `scripts/_backtest/__init__.py` — State only that the package supports `backtest_bugfix_size.py`; remove extraction history and obsolete LOC justification.
- `scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py` — Preserve one-JSON-object stdin, Bash-only lexical grep-token detection, additional-context-only output, no permission decision, and silent successful handling of malformed/nonmatching input. Preserve the intentionally simple lexical matcher.
- `scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_field_validation_probe.sh` — Preserve explicit opt-in, full-output recovery, BSD `mktemp`, ADF decoding, bounded binding/corruption recovery, epic-only hierarchy, two-pass unbound-parent grace, conflict/dedup/status/deletion semantics, bounded convergence, cleanup/restore, and positive status-propagation behavior.
- `scripts/jira-pressure-test/e2e_validation_probe.sh` — Preserve manual opt-in, `--only` scoping, CLI event-store writes, portable filtered counts, bounded settling, preview-cleanliness checks, conflict-policy title tolerance, and Jira/local cleanup.

Consumers are hook settings/docs/tests and the manual Jira pressure-test guide. Preserve exact `# shellcheck disable=SC2329 # invoked via trap` and all `# tickets-boundary-ok` sanctions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The leaf commit changes only comments/docstrings or blank lines in the four declared files; exact directives remain.
- [x] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked session log authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [x] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row showing bloat removal with current rationale retained.
- [x] Focused hook/pressure-test checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass; no missing or FAIL semantic row remains.

## Verification
Run the recorded comment-only guard, focused tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint.
